headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Gross margin contracted 246bps YoY to 50.9% as raw-material inflation ran ahead of calibrated price hikes.
Operating leverage on employee and other costs cushioned the hit, taking EBITDA up 13.9% YoY to INR 568 Mn at a 12.6% margin (–34bps YoY); incl. other income, EBITDA grew 12.5% at a 13.5% margin.
Lower finance cost lifted PAT 21.3% YoY to INR 243 Mn (margin 5.4%).
Demand Outlook & Guidance: The company reiterated mid-teens revenue growth for FY27 (H1: +14.7%), with trade distribution sustaining 15%.
valuation: Outlook and Valuation: Campus delivered H1FY27 revenue growth of 14.7%, driven by 11% volume growth and a 6% ASP uplift.
We value Campus at 35x FY28E EPS, arriving at a revised target price of INR 252, implying 26% upside; we maintain our BUY rating.
